subheader: Every plan includes a number of practitioner accounts. Beyond that, the rate falls with the count.
lead: A practitioner is anyone who can be booked into the appointment book. Reception staff, students on placement and practice owners who no longer treat cost nothing.
note: The band is worked out from the number of practitioner accounts on the first day of the month. Accounts added mid-month are billed pro rata from the day they are created.

bands.text: Covered by the Praxis plan; billed only above the included five.
The usual band for a two-address practice.
Includes a named contact and a quarterly review call.
